title: Your US operation. Connected at every step.
intro: Directly operated US warehouses. Align receiving, inventory and dispatch requirements before launch.

stages.name: Receiving
stages.title: Start with a clear handover.
stages.copy: Align inbound format, receiving checks and shipment documents before your goods arrive.

stages.name: Inventory
stages.title: Know what your operation needs.
stages.copy: Discuss storage requirements, inventory handling and the information you need to plan your next order.

stages.name: Dispatch
stages.title: Prepare the next move.
stages.copy: Confirm order preparation, packing and delivery requirements for each outbound flow.

addition.title: Confirm how you use the system.

items.title: Access & functions
items.copy: Confirm available functions and who can view or change records.

items.title: Data updates
items.copy: Confirm update methods and timing for the records you need.

items.title: Platform / ERP scope
items.copy: Share your platform or ERP. Confirm the supported connection scope.

revision.placement: Keep the warehouse workflow view separate. Place the system requirements in the existing Systems area, consolidating overlapping content rather than repeating it.
